topics.title: Caller Queries Unspecified Monetary Amount
topics.summary: During the broadcast, a caller initiates a discussion by inquiring about an unspecified sum of money. The host responds and continues the conversation without interruption.

topics.title: Sunset Boulevard Collision
topics.summary: During a drive near Sunset Boulevard, Sam Kennison struck another vehicle while backing up. Following the incident, he experienced distress before his brother Bill assessed the situation, revealing details of the exchange with the other driver involved.

topics.title: Sam Kinnison Reflects on a Friend
topics.summary: During an extended conversation, the host recounts his friendship with Sam Kinnison, detailing key moments like assisting Howard Stern and offering support during personal struggles including arrest and his brother’s suicide. He shares anecdotes about their time together at awards shows, a disastrous attempt to get Sam into AA meetings, and the irony of Sam's sober death by drunk driving.”” 54 words” 1 sentence minimum

topics.title: Radio Waves, Earthquakes & a Weird Phone Call
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts discussed radio wave auctions and concert ticket giveaways alongside reports of a major earthquake in Northern Europe causing damage. They also addressed a bizarre phone call about a malfunctioning cellular activator service and an interview with a British rock band discussing their hit song 'I'm Too Sexy,' while incorporating celebrity guests like Sam Kinison and Howard Stern’s interactions.

topics.title: Volcano Ash, Three Stooges Convention, and Brother P Touch
topics.summary: Heavy volcanic ash covers Lyon, France, while fans of The Three Stooges hold a convention in Lewiston, Maine. Simultaneously, a commercial promotes the Brother P Touch label maker for creating professional-looking labels at home.

topics.title: Howard and Richard Discuss a Psychiatrist
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard Stern questions his guest, Richard Simmons, about seeing a psychiatrist. The conversation quickly becomes absurd as Richard recounts a bizarre dinner with a psychiatrist brought by his father involving stolen money, a proposed double wedding with Gary, and an unexpected offer for a Barbie-themed engagement.

topics.title: Non-Admitted Insurance Carriers and Consumer Inquiry
topics.summary: Commissioner Garamendi urges shoppers to inquire about their insurance carrier’s status, specifically asking if it is non-admitted. He emphasizes the potential risks associated with using these carriers and encourages switching insurers due to concerns regarding policyholder protection.

topics.title: Motorola Phones and Personal Frustrations
topics.summary: Listeners are offered Motorola handheld phones with no money down, followed by service activation specialists. A conversation ensues between Ted from Atlanta and callers discussing personal frustrations like demanding bosses, marital issues, and desires for a Denny’s red-eye chili fries meal, revealing anxieties about relationships and work.

topics.title: Navigating Car Purchases with ‘Car Smarts’
topics.summary: After callers describe frustrating experiences trying to purchase cars, they turn to 'Car Smart's,' an independent automotive advisory service. Utilizing access to invoice prices and negotiation tactics, members secured fair deals on their vehicles by avoiding pushy salespeople and receiving professional guidance.

topics.title: Freezing Pool & Christmas Tree Frustration
topics.summary: Howard struggles with a freezing pool in his Los Angeles home, exacerbated by Sam’s inability to adjust the temperature. The situation escalates as an enormous Christmas tree remains stuck inside, leading to being locked out and numerous frustrating interactions with Sam regarding the uncomfortable conditions.
